biggest_catch: It's $100 — but only after you park $2,500 of your own money in a Betterment self-directed investing account and leave it there until the bonus lands around Oct 29, 2026. Withdraw below $2,500 before the bonus date and the $100 vanishes.
catches: You must ENROLL in the Self-Directed Investing Offer and complete qualifying deposits totaling at least $2,500 by 11:59:59 PM ET on October 22, 2026 (including 2-3 business day settlement time).
The $100 bonus is paid on or around October 29, 2026 only if you have not withdrawn below $2,500 of your qualifying deposit before the bonus date.

Qualifying deposits must come from a linked bank or investment account OUTSIDE Betterment — deposits into Betterment Cash Reserve, joint/trust SDI accounts, and internal transfers from Cash Reserve or managed investing accounts do not qualify.

New Betterment clients only; one SDI account per person; US residents only; not valid with any other offers (including the Tiered Investing Reward); excludes Betterment Advisor Solutions advised clients, 401(k) plan participants, and Betterment employees.
The $100 lands inside the SDI investing account — it is invested cash, subject to market risk if you put it to work.

steps: Go to Betterment and open an individual self-directed investing (SDI) account as a new client, and enroll in the Self-Directed Investing Offer during signup.
Link an outside bank or investment account (not another Betterment account).
Deposit new funds totaling at least $2,500 into the SDI account by 11:59:59 PM ET on October 22, 2026 — allow 2-3 business days for settlement, so start early.
Do not withdraw below $2,500 before the bonus date.
The $100 SDI Bonus is deposited into your SDI account on or around October 29, 2026.
